rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for an unspecified person, including requests such as asking whether someone can help.

example.english: Can someone help me move this table?
example.traditional: 有人可以幫我搬張枱嗎？
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 zoeng1 toi2 maa3

rows.note: Use this when introducing or describing someone as one particular person in a situation or story.

example.english: Yesterday, someone waited at the bus stop for a long time.
example.traditional: 尋日有個人喺巴士站等咗好耐。
example.jyutping: cam4 jat6 jau5 go3 jan4 hai2 baa1 si2 zaam6 dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6

rows.note: Use this for a particular but unidentified person when the wording is more formal or written than everyday conversation.

example.english: Someone has been arrested by the police.
example.jyutping: mau5 jan4 ji5 bei6 ging2 fong1 keoi1 bou6
